title.narrative: Output 7.2. Increased capacity of Member States to ensure safe and healthy working conditions

description.narrative: Following the development of the 2nd National OSH Profile in 2021, the 3rd National OSH Programme in Lao PDR was developed and launched in December 2022, under the leadership of the Department of Labor Management and Social Welfare, in partnership with the Lao Federal Trade Union and the Lao National Chamber of Commerce and Industry in addition to working with different government ministries from central to local level. The 5 priorities addressed by the 3rd Programme, identified by social partners, include the development of legal and policy framework, building capacity at all levels, establishment of the collection and management of OSH data, promotion of the OSH management system, and improvement of OSH compliance. With the support of the Government of Korea, the ILO provided technical assistance in the development of the 3rd Programme for the entire process, including the review and evaluation of the implementation of the 2nd National OSH Programme. The ILO further supported the implementation of a national OSH programme, for example, a comparative study on OSH legal framework and C155 and C187, ratified by the country in 2022, for the development of consolidated OSH laws, and the development of a national system of collection and registration of occupational accident and disease data.
